name: Morning Manna

verse.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

lines: Salvation Ministries has officially launched its 2026 Ghana Miracle Crusade, bringing powerful teaching and worship to Accra.
Minister Theophilus Sunday hosted Day One of Tarry Nyanya 2026, preparing believers through intense prayer and worship.
Archaeologists have discovered the world's oldest shipwreck off the Turkish coast, shedding light on ancient Mediterranean trade.
Ghana's Black Queens have announced their starting lineup for the crucial Olympic qualifier against Mauritius at Essipong.
Pope Leo XIV is recovering well in the hospital following a successful lung cancer surgery.
prayers: Lord, grant swift healing and complete recovery to Pope Leo XIV and all who are fighting illness today.
We pray for divine protection and success for our national team athletes representing Ghana in international competitions.
Father, let Your grace and peace rest upon all believers attending spiritual gatherings across the nation this week.
